checks.scope: Disposable PostgreSQL race where publisher one pauses during transport publication, its lease expires, publisher two reclaims and commits, and publisher one finishes late. The stale publisher reports skipped, does not cancel the live dispatch, and leaves one dispatch row, one DISPATCHED event, and publisher fence version 2.
checks.residual: Proves database settlement fencing and cancellation classification for the exercised publisher race. Does not prove external transport deduplication across response-loss or close all SPEC-277 durable receipt and authority obligations.

checks.scope: PR #641 merged a raw-SQL timestamp serialization fix and direct PostgreSQL acceptance for due-poll claims, completed result persistence, exactly-once capacity release, duplicate observations, stale poller results after lease reclaim, and cancellation-versus-completion races.
